releaseNotes: Strengthens the offline passage-commentary library with 173 distinct primary passages, replacing three duplicate short notes with contextual studies on Josiah's rediscovery of Scripture, Psalm 90 and Jesus' teaching on care for vulnerable people. Adds KJV validation for every commentary primary passage and related reference, including cross-chapter range boundaries. Retains the 110-term Hebrew, Greek and Aramaic word-study library.
